guarantees.claim: When wipe_secret is false and cfg_block is true, secret_key_d is held at the current secret_key value.
When wipe_secret is true, secret_key_d is assigned a 1024-bit vector formed by replicating wipe_v 32 times.

When cfg_block is 0, for every word index i (0..31) where reg2hw.key[31-i].qe is 1, secret_key_d[32*i+:32] is assigned the endian‑swapped value of reg2hw.key[31-i].q using conv_endian32 with key_swap control; words with qe==0 retain the initial secret_key word value.

assumptions.claim: cfg_block is deasserted only when the HMAC engine is idle, so that secret key updates do not corrupt an ongoing operation.
assumptions.risk: If cfg_block is low during an HMAC operation, the secret key could change mid‑computation, leading to incorrect HMAC or key exposure.

assumptions.claim: The reg2hw.key[31-i].qe qualifier bits correctly indicate which key words are valid and the reg2hw.key[31-i].q fields contain the intended new key data.
assumptions.risk: Incorrect qe settings may leave old key words in secret_key_d or overwrite unintended words, compromising key integrity.

assumptions.claim: When wipe_secret is asserted, wipe_v provides a strong wiping constant (e.g., all‑zeros) that erases secret key material.
assumptions.risk: If wipe_v does not fully overwrite the key, residual secret data may remain in secret_key_d after a wipe request.

uncertain_points.claim: The generation of cfg_block is external to this block; an incorrect deassertion could allow secret key updates while an HMAC operation is active.
uncertain_points.risk: Active HMAC computation corruption and potential key leakage.

uncertain_points.claim: The loop index mapping uses reg2hw.key[31-i] (reverse order) to fill secret_key_d words 0..31. It is unclear whether this reversed word order matches the intended secret key buffer layout.
uncertain_points.risk: Misaligned key word ordering could cause incorrect HMAC results.

uncertain_points.claim: secret_key_d must be exactly 32 words of 32 bits to match the loop and slicing; if the actual SECRET_KEY_WIDTH parameter differs, indexing would be out of bounds.
uncertain_points.risk: Index out of range, truncated or misaligned key writes.
